scope: minimum normalized radial fault mixture; exact linear 3state G2/G3 identity; synthetic controls; bounded archived-data shadow diagnosis

model.parameter_provenance: Fixed synthetic engineering assumptions, not fitted or calibrated. Negative component is motivated by already-seen E1 failure; no holdout claim.

threshold_provenance.algebra_rtol: 1e-8 numerical comparison, not a performance claim
threshold_provenance.posterior_component_atol: 1e-8 exact algebra and independent numerical integral
threshold_provenance.rf_dominance_threshold: 0.95 exploratory decision threshold from previous plan, not calibrated probability
threshold_provenance.performance: No additional pooled win-rate or universal-improvement gate

fixtures.purpose: recover original extreme discrepancy in a scalar surrogate
do not blindly follow a too-short RF observation
do not force faulty long RF

alias_pair.purpose: bound identifiability from identical available inputs; not an observed second event

sensitivity.purpose: diagnose prior-dependence without selecting a best parameter after scoring

reuse.D0_D4: REUSED_VERIFIED for original immutable artifact only; no old scientific_PASS imported

hypothesis_policy: Contradiction blocks the affected acceptance claim, not valid math or preregistered bounded diagnostic. A different estimator/feature/physical prior requires a separately amended contract and user confirmation.

failure_policy.nonfinite_or_bad_integral: CASE_RESULT_INVALID for affected fixture; track denominator
failure_policy.missing_optional_metadata: DIAGNOSTIC_DEFECT_OR_WARNING; no state mutation; unaffected calculations continue
failure_policy.hypothesis_counterexample: CLAIM_BLOCK for that claim; preregistered diagnosis may continue
failure_policy.untrained_quality_and_fault_prior: CLAIM_BLOCK for online source identification/generalization; synthetic/diagnostic execution allowed
